setup: A fraction is being compared with the benchmarks 0, 1/2 and 1.

steps.say: The numerator [[n]] measures how many equal parts are taken while the denominator fixes the size of each part.
Half of the denominator marks the halfway point: a numerator below it sits nearer 0 and a numerator above it sits nearer 1.
Comparing the distance to each benchmark shows which one is closest.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
